summary: The PR addresses the issue of visibility for unittest setUpClass fixtures by prefixing their names with an underscore. However, it does not address the broader issue of documenting these fixtures.

issues.description: The PR only hides the fixtures without addressing the underlying issue of missing documentation. This could lead to confusion for users who expect these fixtures to be documented.
The PR does not include any updates to the documentation to reflect the change in behavior regarding the visibility of unittest setUpClass fixtures.
